description: A pension that exists. The good is the absence of a particular worry rather than the presence of a pleasure, which is why it is hard to describe and easy to underrate.

description: A pension that exists stops being an event and becomes a reference point - retold, compared against, and eventually shorthand inside one family for a whole kind of day.

notes: Experiential purchases retain value through memory where material ones decay; people are markedly unwilling to trade the memory away.
